title: Copy vs reference
prompt: Implement `static (int, int) Twist()` that: creates a struct point (3,4), assigns it to a second variable, mutates the second to (10,20), and returns the FIRST point's coordinates. Structs copy on assignment — the first must be untouched.

tests.name: struct-copy
tests.hint: Mutating the copy must not touch the original — return the original's fields.
